note: The DAILY UPDATE'S WATCHLIST SCREENSHOT: a dated, per-ticker market read of the author's own names. The 2026 daily and mid-week updates carry a TradingView screenshot of his watchlist, one chart per ticker, each with the ticker's change and the price. The rows are read off the frame by eye.
notes: The screens are DARK (white text on a black chart) and the OCR needs the region inverted to read them well.

The ticker labels are THIRTY pixels tall, against the eight to thirteen of the panel video frames -- which is why this screenshot is the better source for a dated market read than the panel reader is.
Each chart carries the ticker, the date, the change, the change percentage and the price, and the panels are laid out in a grid whose shape varies with the number of names.
